zh.name: 黄泉
zh.desc: 自称「巡海游侠」的旅人，本名不详。\n身佩一柄长刀，独行银河。

1.name: 高天寥落真言始
1.desc: 对处于<u>负面效果</u>的敌方目标造成伤害时暴击率提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。

10000010.name: 负面效果
10000010.desc: 对战斗有负面效果的所有持续状态，若无特殊说明则可以被解除。

2.name: 霆鼓俱寂，瑟风亦止
2.desc: 行迹【奈落】最高数值所需求「虚无」命途角色的数量减少1名，自身回合开始时获得1点【残梦】，同时为【集真赤】最多的敌方附上1层【集真赤】。

3.name: 寒肃惊永蛰
3.desc: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过<unbreak>10</unbreak>级。

4.name: 亘焰燎照镜中人
4.desc: 在敌方目标进入战斗时，使其陷入终结技伤害易伤状态，受到的终结技伤害提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>。

5.name: 崇岩支离，千身飘零
5.desc: 战技等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过<unbreak>15</unbreak>级。

6.name: 灾咎解桎梏
6.desc: 黄泉造成的终结技伤害全属性<u>抗性穿透</u>提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>，施放普攻、战技造成的伤害同时视为终结技伤害，并无视弱点属性削减敌方韧性。击破弱点时，触发雷属性的弱点击破效果。

30000005.name: 抗性穿透
30000005.desc: 当造成伤害时，无视敌方目标的一部分对应伤害属性的抗性值。

130801.name: 虚隙一顾…枯骨眠霜
130801.desc: 队友攻击带有【集真赤】的敌方目标后，黄泉发动<u>追加攻击</u>，对敌方全体造成等同于黄泉<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>攻击力的雷属性伤害，随后造成6次伤害，每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于黄泉<unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>攻击力的雷属性伤害，获得<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>点残梦并为【集真赤】最多的敌方目标附上<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>层【集真赤】。本次<u>追加攻击</u>造成伤害时，被视为造成了终结技伤害。\n该效果每回合最多触发<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>次。黄泉回合开始时重置可触发次数。行迹【奈落】对本次<u>追加攻击</u>也会生效。

10000004.name: 追加攻击
10000004.desc: 满足条件时自动触发的效果，对目标施放1次额外的攻击。

130801.name: 三途枯榷
130801.desc: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害。
130801.simple_desc: 对敌方单体造成少量雷属性伤害。

130802.name: 八雷飞渡
130802.desc: 获得<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>点【残梦】，为指定敌方单体附上<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>层【集真赤】，对其造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害，同时对其相邻目标造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害。
130802.simple_desc: 获得<color=#f29e38ff><color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>点【残梦】</color>，为敌方单体附上<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color>层【集真赤】，对其造成雷属性伤害，对相邻目标造成少量雷属性伤害。

130803.name: 残梦尽染，一刀缭断
130803.desc:
依次发动3次【啼泽雨斩】和1次【黄泉返渡】，对指定敌方单体最多造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害，对其他目标最多造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害。
【啼泽雨斩】：对指定敌方单体造成等同于黄泉攻击力<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>的雷属性伤害，并消去目标最多3层【集真赤】。消去【集真赤】时，立即对敌方全体造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害，每消去1层【集真赤】本次伤害倍率额外提高，最多提高至<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[f1]%</unbreak></color>。
【黄泉返渡】：对敌方全体造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害并移除所有【集真赤】。
终结技期间无法为敌方附上【集真赤】。
130803.simple_desc: 对敌方单体造成3段少量雷属性伤害，若消去目标【集真赤】则对敌方全体造成少量雷属性伤害。最后对敌方全体造成1段雷属性伤害并移除所有【集真赤】。

130804.name: 红叶时雨，万倾一空
130804.desc: 【残梦】达到<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点时可激活终结技。终结技期间可无视弱点属性削减敌方韧性，并使敌方全体全属性抗性降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，持续至终结技结束。\n任意单位施放技能期间使敌方目标陷入负面效果，黄泉获得1点【残梦】并为目标附上1层【集真赤】，若使多个目标陷入负面效果，则为其中【集真赤】最多的敌方目标附上1层【集真赤】。该效果每次施放技能最多触发1次。\n黄泉在场时，敌方目标离场或被任意单位消灭后，其持有的【集真赤】会转移至全场【集真赤】最多的敌方目标。
130804.simple_desc: 【残梦】达到上限时可激活终结技。终结技期间可<color=#f29e38ff>无视弱点属性</color>削减敌方韧性，并使敌方全体<color=#f29e38ff>全属性抗性降低</color>。\n任意单位施放技能期间使敌方目标陷入负面效果，黄泉获得【残梦】并为敌方目标附上【集真赤】。

130806.name: 攻击
130806.desc: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

130807.name: 四相断我
130807.desc: 立即攻击敌人，每个波次开始时获得【四相断我】，对敌方全体造成等同于黄泉<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>攻击力的雷属性伤害，且无视弱点属性削减敌方全体的韧性，击破弱点时，触发雷属性的弱点击破效果。\n【四相断我】：施放终结技后黄泉获得<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>点【残梦】，并为敌方随机单体附上<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>层【集真赤】。\n若攻击普通敌人则立即将其消灭，不会进入战斗。未击中敌人时不消耗秘技点。
130807.simple_desc: 攻击敌人，每个波次开始时获得【四相断我】，对敌方全体造成雷属性伤害，并<color=#f29e38ff>无视弱点属性</color>削减韧性。\n若攻击普通敌人则<color=#f29e38ff>立即将其消灭</color>，不会进入战斗。未击中敌人时不消耗秘技点。

130814.name: 啼泽雨斩
130814.simple_desc: 对敌方单体造成少量雷属性伤害，并消去目标最多3层【集真赤】。消去【集真赤】时，对敌方全体造成1次少量雷属性伤害，每消去1层【集真赤】本次伤害倍率提高。

130815.name: 啼泽雨斩
130815.simple_desc: 对敌方单体造成少量雷属性伤害，并消去目标最多3层【集真赤】。消去【集真赤】时，对敌方全体造成1次少量雷属性伤害，每消去1层【集真赤】本次伤害倍率提高。

130816.name: 啼泽雨斩
130816.simple_desc: 对敌方单体造成少量雷属性伤害，并消去目标最多3层【集真赤】。消去【集真赤】时，对敌方全体造成1次少量雷属性伤害，每消去1层【集真赤】本次伤害倍率提高。

130817.name: 黄泉返渡
130817.simple_desc: 对敌方全体造成雷属性伤害并移除所有【集真赤】。

1.point_desc: 战斗开始时，立即获得<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点【残梦】，并为随机1名敌方附上<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>层【集真赤】。当【残梦】达到上限时，每溢出1点【残梦】获得1层【四相断我】，使【四相断我】最多可以叠加至<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>层。
我方队伍中存在1名/2名除黄泉之外的「虚无」命途角色时，使黄泉普攻、战技、终结技造成的伤害为原伤害的<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>/<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>。

终结技的【啼泽雨斩】击中持有【集真赤】的敌方目标时，使黄泉造成的伤害提高<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>，该效果最多叠加<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>层，持续<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>回合，并在发动【黄泉返渡】时额外造成<unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak>次伤害，每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于黄泉<unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak>攻击力的雷属性伤害，该伤害视为终结技伤害。

en.name: Acheron
en.desc: A drifter claiming to be a Galaxy Ranger. Her true name is unknown.\nShe walks the cosmos alone, carrying with her a long sword.

1.name: Silenced Sky Spake Sooth
1.desc: When dealing DMG to <u>debuffed</u> enemies, increases CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

10000010.name: Debuff
10000010.desc: All status effects that provide negative combat debuffs, can be dispelled unless stated otherwise.

2.name: Mute Thunder in Still Tempest
2.desc: The number of Nihility characters required for the Trace "The Abyss" to achieve its highest possible effect is reduced by 1. When this unit's turn starts, gains 1 point of Slashed Dream and inflicts 1 stack of Crimson Knot on the enemy with the most Crimson Knot stacks.

3.name: Frost Bites in Death
3.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

4.name: Shrined Fire for Mirrored Soul
4.desc: When enemy targets enter combat, inflicts them with the Ultimate DMG Vulnerability, increasing the amount of Ultimate DMG they take by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

5.name: Strewn Souls on Erased Earths
5.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

6.name: Apocalypse, the Emancipator
6.desc: Increases the All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> for the Ultimate DMG dealt by Acheron by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. The DMG dealt by Basic ATK and Skill will also be considered as Ultimate DMG and can Reduce enemy Toughness regardless of Weakness Types. When breaking Weaknesses, triggers the Lightning Weakness Break effect.

30000005.name: RES PEN
30000005.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

130801.name: A Glance Through Rime to Bone
130801.desc: When a teammate attacks an enemy target with "Crimson Knot," Acheron deals 1 instance of Lightning <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of this unit's ATK to the target and launches a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, dealing Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Acheron's ATK to all enemies, then gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Slashed Dream and inflicts <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Crimson Knot" on the enemy target with the most "Crimson Knot."\nThis effect can trigger up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> time(s) per turn. The trigger count resets at the start of Acheron's turn.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

130801.name: Trilateral Wiltcross
130801.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to one designated enemy target.
130801.simple_desc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy.

130802.name: Octobolt Flash
130802.desc: Gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Slashed Dream." Inflicts <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Crimson Knot" on one designated enemy target, dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to this target, as well as Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to adjacent targets.
130802.simple_desc: Gains <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> point(s) of Slashed Dream. Inflicts <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak></color> stack(s) of Crimson Knot on one enemy, dealing Lightning DMG to this target, as well as minor Lightning DMG to adjacent targets.

130803.name: Slashed Dream Cries in Red
130803.desc:
Sequentially unleash "Rainblade" 3 times and "Stygian Resurge" 1 time, dealing Lightning DMG up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to one designated enemy target, as well as Lightning DMG up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to other targets.
"Rainblade": Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to one designated enemy target and removes up to 3 stacks of "Crimson Knot" from the target. When "Crimson Knot" is removed, immediately deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to all enemies. For every stack of "Crimson Knot" removed, this DMG Multiplier is additionally increased, up to a maximum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[f1]%</unbreak></color>.
"Stygian Resurge": Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to all enemies and remove all "Crimson Knots."
"Crimson Knot" cannot be applied to enemies during the Ultimate.
130803.simple_desc: Deals 3 hits of minor Lightning DMG to one enemy. If "Crimson Knot" is removed from the target, then deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies. Finally, deals 1 hit of Lightning DMG to all enemies and removes all "Crimson Knots."

130804.name: Atop Rainleaf Hangs Oneness
130804.desc: When Slashed Dream reaches <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s), the Ultimate can be activated. During the Ultimate, reduces enemies' Toughness regardless of Weakness Types and reduces all enemies' All-Type RES by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting until the end of the Ultimate.\nWhen any unit inflicts debuffs on an enemy target while using their ability, Acheron gains 1 point of Slashed Dream and inflicts 1 stack of Crimson Knot on a target. If debuffs are inflicted on multiple targets, then the 1 stack of Crimson Knot will be inflicted on the enemy target with the most Crimson Knot stacks. This effect can only trigger once for every ability use.\nAfter an enemy target exits the field or gets defeated by any unit while Acheron is on the field, their Crimson Knot stacks will be transferred to the enemy target with the most Crimson Knot stacks on the whole field.
130804.simple_desc: When Slashed Dream reaches its upper limit, the Ultimate can be activated. During the Ultimate, reduces enemies' Toughness <color=#f29e38ff>regardless of Weakness Types</color> and reduces all enemies' <color=#f29e38ff>All-Type RES</color>.\nWhen any unit inflicts debuffs on an enemy target while using their ability, Acheron gains Slashed Dream and inflicts Crimson Knot on an enemy target.

130806.name: Attack
130806.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

130807.name: Quadrivalent Ascendance
130807.desc: Immediately attacks the enemy. At the start of each wave, gains Quadrivalent Ascendance, dealing Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Acheron's ATK to all enemies and reducing Toughness of all enemies irrespective of Weakness Types. When breaking Weaknesses, triggers the Lightning Weakness Break effect.\nQuadrivalent Ascendance: After using the Ultimate, Acheron gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Slashed Dream and inflicts <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Crimson Knot on a single random enemy.\nIf attacking a normal enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. When not hitting enemies, no Technique Points are consumed.
130807.simple_desc: Attacks the enemy. At the start of each wave, gains Quadrivalent Ascendance, dealing Lightning DMG to all enemies and reducing Toughness <color=#f29e38ff>regardless of Weakness Types</color>.\nIf attacking a normal enemy, <color=#f29e38ff>immediately defeats them</color> without entering combat. When not hitting enemies, no Technique Points are consumed.

130814.name: Rainblade
130814.simple_desc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy, and removes up to 3 stacks of "Crimson Knot" from the target. When "Crimson Knot" is removed, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies 1 time, with this DMG multiplier increased for every stack of "Crimson Knot" removed.

130815.name: Rainblade
130815.simple_desc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy, and removes up to 3 stacks of "Crimson Knot" from the target. When "Crimson Knot" is removed, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies 1 time, with this DMG multiplier increased for every stack of "Crimson Knot" removed.

130816.name: Rainblade
130816.simple_desc: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one enemy, and removes up to 3 stacks of "Crimson Knot" from the target. When "Crimson Knot" is removed, deals minor Lightning DMG to all enemies 1 time, with this DMG multiplier increased for every stack of "Crimson Knot" removed.

130817.name: Stygian Resurge
130817.simple_desc: Deals Lightning DMG to all enemies and removes all Crimson Knots.

1.point_desc: When battle starts, immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Slashed Dream and applies <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Crimson Knot to a random enemy. When Slashed Dream reaches its upper limit, for every point of Slashed Dream that exceeds the limit, gains 1 stack of Quadrivalent Ascendance. Enables Quadrivalent Ascendance to stack up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s).

When there are 1 or 2 Nihility characters other than Acheron in the team, the DMG dealt by Acheron's Basic ATK, Skill, and Ultimate increases to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the original DMG respectively.

When the Ultimate's Rainblade hits enemy targets that have Crimson Knot, the DMG dealt by Acheron increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, stacking up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> time(s) and lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). And when Stygian Resurge triggers, additionally deals DMG for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> times. Each time deals Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of Acheron's ATK to a single random enemy and is considered as Ultimate DMG.
